title.zh: 十二种界面语言真实路由

purpose.en: Fix the release-blocking defect where Japanese, Korean, and other selectable interface languages silently rendered the English site.
purpose.zh: 修复选择日语、韩语及其他界面语言后仍静默显示英文站点的上线阻断问题。

en: Give every selectable language its own stable URL and saved interface preference.
Localize the homepage, desktop and mobile navigation, footer, language menu, and Today’s Sprint entry.
Apply the correct HTML language, writing direction, and native language label.
zh: 为每一种可选语言提供独立稳定网址并保存界面语言偏好。
本地化首页、桌面与手机导航、页脚、语言菜单及今日速成入口。
正确设置 HTML 语言、书写方向和语言原生名称。

en: Remove the former non-Chinese-to-English route alias from the interface language menu.
Add one typed twelve-language interface registry and static localized homepage dictionaries.
Add a regression contract proving each selectable language is a real route rather than an English alias.
zh: 删除旧语言菜单把所有非中文语言映射为英文路由的逻辑。
新增一套强类型十二语言界面注册表和静态首页本地化词典。
新增回归合同，证明每种可选语言都是真实路由而非英文别名。

en: TypeScript passes with all twelve interface locale types.
All 333 repository tests pass, including the new real-route localization contract.
The verified vinext production build, artifact validation, and sensitive-data scan pass.
After deployment, use real Chrome to switch to Japanese and Korean and verify visible text, URL, hamburger menu, footer, and Sprint dialog.
zh: 十二种界面语言类型全部通过 TypeScript 检查。
333 项仓库测试全部通过，包含新增真实语言路由合同。
vinext 正式构建、产物验证和敏感信息扫描通过。
发布后使用真实 Chrome 切换日语与韩语，验证正文、网址、汉堡菜单、页脚和今日速成弹窗。

en: Secondary authenticated and administrative pages remain in the continuing page-by-page portfolio localization migration; this release removes the public language-switching blocker first.
zh: 登录后及管理类次级页面继续按页面逐项迁移；本次先解除公开语言切换的阻断问题。

en: SmartLingo keeps its twelve learning-language catalog separate from the learner’s interface language while using the same supported codes.
zh: SmartLingo 继续把学习目标语言与学习者界面语言分开保存，但两者采用同一套十二种支持语言代码。
